purpose: Research and acquisition registry, not executable connector configuration or accepted dataset manifest.

status_contract.role: Recommendation within its delivery stage; recommended_baseline does not mean all modules are required at startup.
status_contract.default_enabled: False for every candidate. Activation requires selecting and accepting an actual release in the new app.
status_contract.verification: Documentation or bounded metadata checks only, unless verification_notes explicitly states otherwise. No full dataset was acquired in this research.
status_contract.identity_fields: Fields to preserve for source identity, revision and context; not a declaration that all listed fields form a primary key.
status_contract.access_url: May be an API root, catalogue, example query, release archive, S3 prefix or template. Inspect access_kind and access_notes; never fetch every URL automatically.
status_contract.license: Publisher wording summarized for planning. Unknown scope stays unresolved; retain the actual product/release terms and attribution before the affected operation.

datasets.name: GeoNames Gazetteer extract and alternateNamesV2
datasets.reason: Smallest practical global place identity baseline: daily allCountries dump, country/city subsets, and language plus historic alias intervals tied to geonameid.
datasets.format: ZIP containing UTF-8 tab-delimited text; alternateNamesV2.zip is a separate alias table
datasets.license_name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
datasets.license_notes: Attribution required; publisher states commercial use is allowed and data are provided as-is without accuracy, timeliness, or completeness warranty.
datasets.coverage: Global geographical points; country/city subsets and admin code tables. Main records include geonameid, names, WGS84 latitude/longitude, feature class/code, ISO alpha-2 country, admin1-admin4, population, timezone, and modification date.
datasets.update_notes: Publisher describes a daily dump. modification date is last record edit, not a historical snapshot; alternate names have from/to periods and historic flags.
datasets.join_cautions: Admin1 codes are mostly FIPS and have country exceptions; names, ISO codes, and coordinates alone are not unique joins. Keep alternateNamesV2 separate from the convenience alternatenames string.
datasets.quality_limits: Aggregates over 100 sources; coverage and accuracy vary by country. Point records and simplified country shapes are not a substitute for authoritative administrative polygons.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.
datasets.access_notes: Prefer selected-country XX.zip inputs where practical; allCountries is a full global archive, not a startup requirement. Keep alias language/date metadata and documented admin-code exceptions.

datasets.name: geoBoundaries gbOpen
datasets.reason: Programmatic global ADM0-ADM5 boundary catalogue with explicit represented year, source license, source update date, build date, full and simplified geometry URLs, and reproducible archived commits.
datasets.format: JSON metadata API returning GeoJSON, TopoJSON, simplified GeoJSON, and aggregate ZIP URLs
datasets.license_name: CC BY 4.0 for geoBoundaries derivative/open release; original source license per boundary
datasets.license_notes: gbOpen is recommended by the publisher for most uses with attribution. Individual files retain source license metadata; gbAuthoritative is verified in-country but non-commercial, and humanitarian files can have less open licensing.
datasets.coverage: Global country and subnational boundaries exposed as ADM0 through ADM5, with ISO alpha-3 and boundary type selectors; exact country/level coverage varies.
datasets.update_notes: API is a current-release pointer, not a guarantee of current legal geography. Metadata has boundaryYearRepresented, sourceDataUpdateDate, and buildDate; yearly archived releases and dated GitHub commits support reproducibility.
datasets.join_cautions: boundaryID is generated from ISO/type/input metadata/geometry and changes when underlying data changes. Match by source revision plus ISO and level; do not assume one universal ADM hierarchy or legal worldview.
datasets.quality_limits: Boundary source, vintage, geometry detail, and license differ by country. A live USA ADM1 sample represented 2018 data built in 2023; API uptime is not guaranteed.
datasets.verification_notes: Live USA ADM1 metadata sampled: represented year 2018, source/build dates in 2023. No geometry payload import was validated.
datasets.access_notes: USA/ADM1 is a metadata example. Substitute the selected ISO3 and ADM level; follow returned full/simplified geometry links and pin source/release metadata.

datasets.name: Natural Earth cultural and physical vectors
datasets.reason: Lightweight, versioned world map layers for display, locator context, country/state outlines, populated-place labels, airports, and ports; permissive public-domain terms simplify redistribution.
datasets.format: Versioned ZIP Shapefiles; official maintained repository also provides GeoJSON mirrors
datasets.license_name: Public domain
datasets.license_notes: Publisher places all versions in the public domain and permits commercial use, modification, and redistribution; attribution is unnecessary but 'Made with Natural Earth' is suggested.
datasets.coverage: World at 1:10m, 1:50m, and 1:110m scales. 1:50m cultural catalogue includes Admin 0, Admin 1, boundary lines, populated places, airports, and ports.
datasets.update_notes: Themes have independent version/update cycles; the 1:50m page checked lists Admin0/Admin1 v5.1.1, populated places v5.1.2, and an all-cultural v5.1.1 bundle. Keep theme version and download date.
datasets.join_cautions: Codes may be cartographic, absent, or -99; WOF_ID/GEONAMEID are only present where available. Default political boundaries are de facto, with alternate fclass worldview fields.
datasets.quality_limits: Generalized cartography is unsuitable for precise containment, geocoding, facility inventory, or legal boundary claims. Publisher disclaims accuracy and completeness.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.

datasets.name: Overture Maps Places and Divisions themes
datasets.reason: High-value enrichment with GERS IDs, bridge files, changelogs, multilingual names, confidence, places categories/addresses, and division points/areas/boundaries; gated because releases and licensing are more complex.
datasets.format: Cloud-partitioned Parquet/GeoParquet via official S3/Azure prefixes; CLI can export GeoJSON
datasets.license_name: Places: per-source CDLA Permissive 2.0, Apache 2.0 or CC0; Divisions: ODbL 1.0
datasets.license_notes: Places guide says no OSM data and source-dependent licenses. Divisions conflate OSM and geoBoundaries and are ODbL. Keep themes and upstream attribution separate; an OSM-derived derivative database may carry ODbL.
datasets.coverage: Places global, tens of millions of stationary public place points. Divisions global for country/dependency/region/county; sub-county coverage is documented as spotty. Division area supports land versus territorial extents.
datasets.update_notes: Monthly releases. August 2026 examples use release/2026-08-19.0; GERS registry, bridge files, and changelog accompany releases. Places legacy categories field is deprecated for September 2026 in favor of taxonomy/basic_category.
datasets.join_cautions: GERS IDs can churn when conflation splits/merges; use bridge files and changelog. Division political perspectives and is_land/is_territorial semantics must be retained. Never join solely on name or proximity.
datasets.quality_limits: Provider coverage, source license, and confidence vary. Divisions document no cross-source matching step and known subtype errors; places are a conflated promoted-source record rather than a merged canonical truth.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.
datasets.access_notes: This research family must become separate Places and Divisions product/release selections before acquisition. Retain per-feature source attribution and release-specific schema.

datasets.name: OpenStreetMap Planet and history
datasets.category: open map data / detailed regional source
datasets.reason: Excellent detail and temporal history, but raw planet acquisition and processing are disproportionate for a first Relic baseline; use a bounded regional extract only when a concrete need exists.
datasets.format: Weekly compressed OSM XML or PBF; separate history file and changesets
datasets.license_name: Open Data Commons Open Database License 1.0 (ODbL)
datasets.license_notes: Attribution and share-alike obligations apply to adapted databases; downstream extracts may omit metadata. OSM also requires explicit attribution notice and license link.
datasets.coverage: Global volunteered geographic data: nodes, ways, relations, tags, and detailed geometry. Official planet page reports roughly 166 GB XML and 88 GB PBF for the current weekly export checked.
datasets.update_notes: Complete planet snapshots are weekly; history contains older and deleted items. Latest planet is current state and does not contain deleted objects. Regional extracts and diffs can be much more practical.
datasets.join_cautions: Node, way, and relation IDs occupy separate namespaces; always join on type plus id. Nominatim place_id is instance-specific and not a durable identity. Geometry is assembled from referenced nodes/ways/relations.
datasets.quality_limits: Coverage and tagging are uneven and community-maintained; no fixed tag dictionary. Planet scale requires a dedicated ingestion stack, and ODbL implications need an explicit derivative-database policy.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.

datasets.name: World Port Index (Pub. 150)
datasets.reason: Global publisher-maintained port, terminal and harbor reference with a stable WPI number, general coordinates and rich facility/service attributes.
datasets.format: CSV (official), plus GeoPackage, JSON, Shapefile and File Geodatabase through the viewer
datasets.license_name: unknown
datasets.license_notes: The current WPI page does not state a dataset-specific redistribution licence. Preserve NGA attribution and confirm terms before republishing a full copy.
datasets.coverage: Global; thousands of ports, shipping facilities and oil terminals with general locations and 100+ characteristics/services.
datasets.update_notes: Complete content stated as updated monthly; approved editor submissions described by the WPI FAQ as reviewed weekly and then published.
datasets.join_cautions: wpinumber is stable between WPI updates but identifies a port/place record, not a terminal footprint. UN/LOCODE may be absent or represent a broader location; do not join on names alone.
datasets.quality_limits: General reference and planning aid, not exhaustive and not a navigational chart. Coordinates are general points; attributes can be Unknown and do not prove current operation, berth geometry or facility completeness.
datasets.access_notes: Official indexed ArcGIS service metadata identifies layer 0 and MaxRecordCount 3000; root direct metadata fetch timed out. Revalidate the schema and paginate, do not assume a single complete result. Viewer/download route remains available for discovery. No feature payload was validated here.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.
datasets.activation_dependency: Establish applicable bulk-use/export rights and verify the live service/layer schema and completeness before affected operations.

datasets.name: UN/LOCODE
datasets.publisher: United Nations Economic Commission for Europe / UN/CEFACT
datasets.reason: International trade-location code system for crosswalking port and terminal-related records across names and systems.
datasets.format: CSV, TXT and MS Access; SKOS/Turtle also published
datasets.license_name: UN/CEFACT CC BY 4.0 notice with unresolved site-terms scope
datasets.license_notes: The standards footer says CC BY 4.0 while site terms restrict some material reuse. Resolve applicability to the release and intended operation; this catalogue does not grant redistribution rights.
datasets.coverage: Around 250 countries/territories and over 100,000 trade-related locations.
datasets.update_notes: Official production releases are biannual; directory maintenance is continuous and pre-release data may change before the next official release.
datasets.join_cautions: A code identifies an administrative/economic trade location. Function 1 means a port exists within the location, not that the code is a port footprint; terminals may be child codes. Preserve change/status and release revision.
datasets.quality_limits: UNECE says it cannot verify every entry; status and national approval matter. Coordinates are locating aids, not surveyed facility points. RQ entries are under consideration and XX entries are pending removal.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.
datasets.access_notes: Observed official 2025-1 release artifact, not a claim that this is the latest release. Resolve an appropriate official release through the publications catalogue.
datasets.activation_dependency: Resolve release-specific rights and status/change semantics before bulk publication or export.

datasets.name: World EEZ v12 / Maritime Boundaries Geodatabase
datasets.reason: Global EEZ and maritime-boundary polygons/lines with treaty, joint-regime, source and dispute context for scope-aware map filtering.
datasets.format: Shapefile boundary polylines and EEZ polygons; catalogue also offers GeoPackage, 0-360, low-resolution and KML variants
datasets.license_name: CC BY 4.0
datasets.license_notes: Attribute Flanders Marine Institute/MarineRegions and link to marineregions.org; publisher requests users not to host products for download elsewhere.
datasets.coverage: Global EEZ (200 nautical mile) boundaries and polygons, including treaty/joint-regime/disputed-boundary metadata.
datasets.update_notes: Version 12 dated 2023-10-25; new treaties and corrected inconsistencies are described, but no fixed refresh cadence is promised.
datasets.join_cautions: MRGID and country labels are dataset identities, not legal determinations. Preserve version, line type, treaty, joint-regime, dispute and source attributes; do not map by sovereign name alone.
datasets.quality_limits: MarineRegions explicitly includes internal and archipelagic waters in its EEZ delineation, deviating from UNCLOS. Baselines use ESRI Countries 2014/reef fixes; median and connection lines are reconstructed where treaties do not provide a complete line. Asserted and overlapping claims require disclosure.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.

datasets.name: Global Self-consistent Hierarchical High-resolution Geography (GSHHG)
datasets.publisher: Paul Wessel (SOEST, University of Hawai'i) and Walter H. F. Smith (NOAA); distributed by NOAA NCEI
datasets.reason: Consistent global coastline polygons for basemap and geographic containment operations, with explicit hierarchy and source lineage.
datasets.format: ESRI Shapefile or native binary; five resolutions
datasets.license_name: GNU Lesser General Public License v3 or later
datasets.license_notes: Use under LGPL-3.0-or-later and retain attribution; publisher asks commercial modifiers to notify the maintainers.
datasets.coverage: Global WGS84 geographic coastlines, lakes, nested islands, plus rivers and political borders in the broader package.
datasets.update_notes: Version 2.3.7 released 2017-06-15; no newer release cadence was documented during this check.
datasets.join_cautions: IDs are release-specific geometry identities. Select the intended resolution and shoreline level; dateline-split Shapefile pieces may need parent/ancestor handling.
datasets.quality_limits: Static and relatively old; mixed source datums and known uncertainty make it unsuitable for current low-water lines, exact facility footprints or navigation safety. Antarctica offers ice-front and grounding-line choices; lower-resolution river lines can intersect.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.

datasets.name: Port Liner Shipping Connectivity Index (PLSCI), quarterly
datasets.publisher: UN Trade and Development (UNCTAD) and MDS Transmodal
datasets.reason: Comparable port-level economic/network context for ranking liner-service integration, without treating it as live vessel traffic.
datasets.format: Data Centre table with CSV export; table-specific schema and API access should be confirmed from metadata
datasets.license_name: CC BY 3.0 IGO (FAQ), with UNCTAD site-terms caveat
datasets.license_notes: UNCTAD FAQ describes CC BY 3.0 IGO for Data Hub materials, while the copyright page states broader restrictions; verify the table-specific terms before redistribution.
datasets.coverage: Port-level liner shipping connectivity, quarterly from Q1 2006 onward in the Data Centre.
datasets.update_notes: Quarterly release; UNCTAD insight page reported Q2 2026 updated 2026-06-26 and the release calendar schedules the next quarters.
datasets.join_cautions: Do not assume the port label is a WPI or UN/LOCODE key. Confirm metadata and build a reviewed crosswalk; retain quarter and methodology revision.
datasets.quality_limits: An index of liner-network integration, not port calls, vessel position, berth capacity, route truth or incident evidence. Coverage and comparability follow UNCTAD/MDS methodology and may omit non-liner, bulk or local traffic.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.

datasets.name: OurAirports open data
datasets.category: global aerodromes, runways, frequencies and navaids
datasets.reason: Best first global reference layer: nightly CSV dumps, broad coverage, simple joins and public-domain reuse.
datasets.format: UTF-8 CSV; airports.csv, runways.csv, airport-frequencies.csv, navaids.csv, countries.csv, regions.csv
datasets.license_name: Public Domain (publisher statement)
datasets.license_notes: Publisher says all data is released to the Public Domain, with no guarantee of accuracy or fitness for use.
datasets.coverage: Global airports and landing facilities, runways/helipads/waterways, radio frequencies, navaids, countries and first-level regions; community-curated.
datasets.update_notes: Publisher states the full CSV dumps are updated nightly; checked catalogue listed files last modified 2026-09-10.
datasets.join_cautions: OurAirports id is the persistent internal key; ident is the interoperability key and may be an ICAO code when available. Match FAA/ICAO records with namespace, country, coordinates, type and revision; never name-only or code-only joins.
datasets.quality_limits: No accuracy warranty; uneven country coverage; community edits; records include closed, private, heliport and water-surface facilities; not an operational or regulatory source.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.

datasets.name: FAA National Airspace System Resources (NASR) 28-Day Subscription
datasets.publisher: Federal Aviation Administration, Aeronautical Information Services
datasets.category: official U.S. aerodrome, runway-related, navigation and airspace reference
datasets.reason: Optional U.S. authoritative aeronautical reference with effective-cycle handling; not a required global baseline.
datasets.format: CSV package; AIXM 5.0/5.1; ESRI Shape; legacy fixed-width TXT during transition
datasets.license_name: U.S. government FAA public aeronautical data; no explicit open license located
datasets.license_notes: Free download; retain FAA attribution and verify redistribution terms. FAA public-data status does not itself state an open-source license.
datasets.coverage: United States National Airspace System and associated FAA facilities: airports and other landing facilities, location identifiers, navaids, frequencies, ILS, fixes, procedures and Class B/C/D/E and other airspace groups.
datasets.update_notes: AIRAC-aligned 28-day effective cycles with current/preview/archive pages. FAA documentation says legacy TXT is being sunset (targeted 2026-12-24); new entrants already appear only in CSV from the 2026-03-19 cycle.
datasets.join_cautions: FAA LID, ICAO and IATA are distinct namespaces; a LID can identify non-airport facilities. Keep record class and effective cycle. Join to global data using scored code/name/country/coordinate evidence and manual review on conflict.
datasets.quality_limits: U.S.-centric; schema and fields change by NASR release; safety alerts document occasional coordinate and record errors; not a global airport master and not a flight-observation source.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.
datasets.access_notes: The August 6, 2026 CSV URL is an observed example, not a current-cycle default. Discover the intended effective cycle and pin its metadata; review the FAA legacy-format transition.

datasets.name: FAA Releasable Aircraft Registration Database
datasets.publisher: Federal Aviation Administration, Civil Aviation Registry
datasets.category: U.S. civil aircraft registration and airframe metadata
datasets.reason: Best official U.S. tail-mark and airframe enrichment, with master, aircraft-reference, engine-reference and deregistered files refreshed daily.
datasets.format: ZIP containing comma-delimited text files (.txt)
datasets.license_name: Public FAA registry data; no explicit open license located
datasets.license_notes: FAA publishes the archive for public download but does not state an open-data license on the page. Privacy withholding under 49 U.S.C. 44114(b) applies to eligible private-owner information.
datasets.coverage: All U.S. civil aircraft records maintained by the FAA Registry, including registration master, aircraft make/model/series reference, engine reference, document index, deregistered and reserve N-number files.
datasets.update_notes: FAA states data refreshes daily at 23:30 Central. Layout change effective 2024-07-30 added Document Index Doc Type; certificate expiration date was added to Master.
datasets.join_cautions: N-numbers can be reassigned, reserved or changed; serial numbers can be absent or erroneous; Mode S may be unavailable. Use registry jurisdiction plus registration, serial when present, source date and status. Do not infer a sighting or location from registry data.
datasets.quality_limits: U.S.-only; permissible fields may be blank; deregistered/status timing needs interpretation; owner/address fields are sensitive and may be withheld; no global registration coverage.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.

datasets.name: ICAO API Data Service: DOC 7910 and DOC 8643 reference data
datasets.category: official global aerodrome location and aircraft type code crosswalks
datasets.reason: Strongest standards-aligned source for normalizing ICAO airport/location indicators and aircraft type designators.
datasets.format: JSON or CSV API responses; full datasets offered as Excel or JSON
datasets.license_name: ICAO API Data Service Terms and Conditions; licensing agreement may apply
datasets.license_notes: API key required. ICAO offers 100 free trial calls, then paid booster/full-dataset/unlimited plans; certain purchases may require a licensing agreement.
datasets.coverage: Global DOC 7910 four-letter aerodrome/location indicators with country, location name, coordinates, codcoun and IATA where known; DOC 8643 aircraft type designators and related manufacturer/type reference data.
datasets.update_notes: ICAO says the service is continuously updated; API access and full-dataset packages depend on an account/key and plan.
datasets.join_cautions: Location indicators are code references, not complete airport geometry or runway entities. Aircraft type designators identify a type/family, not a particular airframe; keep registration and serial identities separate.
datasets.quality_limits: Requires key and potentially paid license; no complete runway/airspace geometry or worldwide registration master; API quotas and terms constrain bulk acquisition.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.

datasets.name: UK CAA G-INFO Download
datasets.category: UK civil aircraft registration and technical metadata
datasets.reason: High-quality national registry for UK-specific adjudication, but paid monthly Excel delivery and restrictive database rights make it unsuitable as an initial global dependency.
datasets.format: MS Excel (.xlsx), supplied by order/subscription
datasets.license_name: CAA copyright and database right; all rights reserved
datasets.license_notes: CAA conditions prohibit copying/distribution without written consent and authorize use on one PC unless additional licensing is arranged; paid product.
datasets.coverage: UK Register of Civil Aircraft; overview says 18,000+ aircraft, while conditions text references a register currently over 21,000. Includes marks, current/first registration, previous identity, type/manufacturer/serial, engines and airworthiness/technical fields.
datasets.update_notes: Register changes continuously; G-INFO is compiled monthly. CAA warns records may change after compilation and supplied format may change.
datasets.join_cautions: Registration marks and previous identities need UK jurisdiction and effective dates. Serial numbers remain the preferred airframe linkage when present, with manual review for changes/imports.
datasets.quality_limits: UK-only, paid, not a live API, monthly vintage, potential post-compilation changes, restrictive redistribution and single-PC terms.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.

datasets.name: Global Integrated Power Tracker
datasets.reason: Current global facility and unit baseline spanning coal, oil/gas, solar, wind, hydropower, geothermal, bioenergy and nuclear power; documented status, capacity, ownership, dates and location fields.
datasets.format: XLS/XLSX tracker download (release-scoped workbook)
datasets.license_name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) for tracker data
datasets.license_notes: Attribution, source URI, licence notice and modification notice are required when sharing. GEM.wiki prose may carry a separate wiki licence; do not copy it as dataset content.
datasets.coverage: GEM reports 200 country/areas and 182,400 power facilities in the August 2026 release; eight underlying power trackers retain technology-specific thresholds. Nuclear scope is power units, not the full nuclear fuel cycle.
datasets.update_notes: Most recent checked release August 2026; GIPT rolls forward after underlying tracker releases, whose cadence differs by technology.
datasets.join_cautions: Provider IDs are stable only within GEM's versioned identity history. Plant, unit and phase are different grains; preserve source IDs and release. Names/country strings are not unique keys.
datasets.quality_limits: Compiled research, not real-time dispatch or regulator status. Coordinates can be approximate; thresholds and country-level aggregates create gaps. Missing records cannot support absence claims.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.

datasets.name: Power Reactor Information System (PRIS)
datasets.reason: Optional civil-power-reactor corroboration after confirming the applicable access/reuse basis; does not cover all nuclear-related sites.
datasets.format: Public HTML statistics/reports; detailed PRIS Statistics via registered account
datasets.license_name: No permissive database redistribution licence identified; IAEA access/subscription terms apply
datasets.license_notes: Public status tables and publications are viewable. Detailed statistics require registration; the checked subscription agreement describes password-controlled access and free access until further notice. Confirm permission before bulk storing or redistributing detailed rows.
datasets.coverage: Worldwide civil electricity reactors in operation, construction and shutdown/decommissioning categories, with reactor design and performance history.
datasets.update_notes: IAEA catalogue describes continuous updating; public pages show dated last-update stamps and annual publications. Checked public status page displayed 2026 updates.
datasets.join_cautions: No universal cross-provider identifier was verified. Reactor/unit versus plant/site grain differs from GEM. Normalize aliases and retain IAEA page/report references.
datasets.quality_limits: Civil power-reactor scope only: excludes research reactors, enrichment, fuel fabrication, waste, safeguards and other nuclear-related sites. Detailed access and redistribution rights are gated/unclear.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.
datasets.activation_dependency: Identify eligible public tables or authorized detailed access and the applicable retention/export rights.

datasets.name: GEM fixed oil/gas extraction, pipeline and LNG-terminal tracker family
datasets.reason: Fills the power-only baseline's oil/gas lifecycle, transmission pipeline, LNG terminal and route gaps with public asset-level research datasets.
datasets.format: XLS/XLSX; GGIT also GeoJSON, GeoPackage and shapefile; GOIT route GIS where available
datasets.license_name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) for tracker data
datasets.license_notes: Use tracker-download attribution and preserve release/citations. GEM.wiki content may have separate terms.
datasets.coverage: GOGET extraction fields/areas; GOIT crude oil and NGL transmission pipelines; GGIT gas transmission pipelines and LNG terminals. No refinery inventory; distribution/gathering pipelines excluded.
datasets.update_notes: Tracker releases differ: checked pages list extraction March 2026, oil infrastructure March 2025, gas pipelines November 2025 and LNG terminals September 2025. Resolve the intended release; do not infer a common family vintage.
datasets.join_cautions: Field, asset, pipeline phase, terminal project and LNG carrier are distinct grains. Preserve exact/approximate location flags and separate operating from proposed/inferred statuses.
datasets.quality_limits: Routes may be traced or approximated; coverage is not complete for shorter pipelines or countries with limited public data. GOGET excludes smaller fields below its production/reserve thresholds. Status is researched, not real-time.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.
datasets.access_notes: Select a concrete fixed-asset tracker, release and workbook/layer before importing. Ship/carrier subproducts are outside this selection; KeelWatch owns ship observations/history.

datasets.name: EIA Form EIA-860 and Refinery Capacity Report
datasets.reason: Regulator-grade U.S. validation layer for generator lifecycle records and individual refinery capacity, useful for checking global compilations where U.S. assets overlap.
datasets.format: EIA API v2; ZIP/XLS/XLSX bulk files and reports
datasets.license_name: EIA API Terms of Service / U.S. public data reuse policy
datasets.license_notes: API key registration required. Attribute EIA, do not imply endorsement, respect access limits and API terms. The terms are not a blanket global open-database licence.
datasets.coverage: U.S. electric plants/generators (EIA-860, >=1 MW combined nameplate) and U.S. states/territories individual refinery capacity (EIA-820 report).
datasets.update_notes: EIA-860 has annual files; checked page lists 2025 early release. Refinery Capacity Report for January 1, 2026 released June 26, 2026; next release June 2027. API documentation had March 2026 v2 updates.
datasets.join_cautions: Plant, generator and refinery are separate grains. EIA IDs are U.S.-specific; do not assume they match GEM/WRI IDs or globally unique names.
datasets.quality_limits: Not global. Retired-generator history is not fully comprehensive in every EIA-860 tab; refinery reports describe capacity and survey status, not live operations or incidents.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.

datasets.name: Global Power Plant Database v1.3.0
datasets.reason: Useful open global CSV cross-check with geolocated plants, but stale maintenance and historical generation limitations make it unsuitable as a current baseline.
datasets.format: CSV (v1.3.0); portal layer ZIP
datasets.license_name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
datasets.license_notes: v1.3.0 release is documented under CC BY 4.0; retain WRI attribution and release/version. Associated code is MIT, which is separate from data rights.
datasets.coverage: Approximately 30,000 plants in 164 countries in the documented release, across thermal and renewable technologies; each plant is geolocated.
datasets.update_notes: Official WRI repository states the project was not maintained and had no planned updates as of early 2022. Portal notes generation values cover 2013–2017 and may be calendar, fiscal or regulatory year.
datasets.join_cautions: Plant-level data does not equal GEM unit/phase or PRIS reactor grain. Historical names and coordinates require fuzzy matching and source-version retention.
datasets.quality_limits: No reliable current lifecycle status; stale coverage and historical generation. Do not derive present operating/retired assertions or absence from missing rows.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.

datasets.name: Overture Maps Buildings
datasets.reason: Optional scoped standardized building geometry; compare with a regional OSM extract instead of mandating both.
datasets.format: GeoParquet (WKB geometry; building and building_part feature types)
datasets.license_name: Open Database License 1.0 (ODbL), with upstream attribution requirements
datasets.license_notes: Overture says OSM is included and other sources are checked for ODbL compatibility or compatible terms; retain OSM/Overture attribution and review source terms before redistribution. STAC discovery endpoint: https://stac.overturemaps.org/catalog.json. Azure mirror is documented by Overture.
datasets.coverage: Global; human-made permanent or semi-permanent structures. building is an outer footprint/roofprint; building_part is linked to a parent building via building_id.
datasets.update_notes: Monthly release cadence. Checked documentation showed release 2026-08-19.0, GERS registry, bridge files for one-to-one matches, and a data changelog. Use STAC to resolve future releases.
identity_fields: id (GERS ID; assigned to building, not building_part)
datasets.join_cautions: GERS IDs are intended to be stable but geometry and attributes can change. A building_part has no independent GERS ID. Spatially joining to roads or facilities requires CRS and footprint-overlap rules; retain release and source lineage.
datasets.quality_limits: Many footprints are ML-derived and have lower precision, especially in the Global South. Filtering may omit valid small structures; containers, carports, and solar panels can resemble buildings. A footprint does not establish occupancy, current use, or operational status.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.
datasets.access_notes: Observed August 19, 2026 release prefix with an object glob, not a single downloadable file or a latest-release guarantee. Resolve selected regional objects/row groups and retain the concrete keys.

datasets.name: Overture Maps Transportation
datasets.reason: Optional scoped standardized transport geometry; substantial OSM ancestry overlaps Geofabrik and is not independent confirmation.
datasets.format: GeoParquet (WKB geometry; segment LineString and connector Point feature types)
datasets.license_name: Open Database License 1.0 (ODbL), with upstream attribution requirements
datasets.license_notes: Primary source is OSM, enhanced with TomTom and other authoritative regional sources; Overture publishes the theme under ODbL. Retain OSM/Overture attribution and source/release provenance. STAC discovery endpoint: https://stac.overturemaps.org/catalog.json.
datasets.coverage: Global; segment subtypes are road, rail, and water. Segment geometry is a path centerline; connector geometry marks network junctions.
datasets.update_notes: Monthly releases include GERS registry, GERS IDs, bridge files, and changelog. Checked documentation showed release 2026-08-19.0 and separate segment/connector cloud paths.
identity_fields: id (GERS ID for segment or connector)
datasets.join_cautions: Segments may be merged or split between releases; splitter-derived records can repeat a GERS ID with linear references. A centerline is not a surveyed corridor boundary. Access, speed, route, and operational interpretations require explicit scope and source date.
datasets.quality_limits: Overture reports duplicate, overlap, sharp-turn, gap, and invalid-intersection checks, but the network remains a conflation of OSM, commercial, and regional sources. It excludes pipelines, electric lines, open navigable spaces, and aerial paths. Presence does not prove current operation.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.
datasets.access_notes: Observed August 19, 2026 release prefix with an object glob. Select a concrete release and bounded area; resolve actual object keys. This is not a full pipeline/electric-grid inventory.

datasets.name: Geofabrik regional OpenStreetMap PBF extracts
datasets.reason: Owner-confirmed input for regional OSM enrichment: names/aliases, facilities, buildings, transport and land/water context. Select areas explicitly; not a global startup download.
datasets.format: Public .osm.pbf snapshots; compatible regional .osc.gz updates only when incremental refresh is implemented.
datasets.license_name: Open Database License 1.0 (ODbL)
datasets.license_notes: Geofabrik states that all OSM-derived data on its public download server is ODbL, with OpenStreetMap acknowledgement and share-alike for derived databases. The regional catalogue provides exact latest and dated URLs, for example https://download.geofabrik.de/europe/portugal-latest.osm.pbf.
datasets.coverage: Selected countries/subregions from the publisher index. Retained crossing ways/multipolygons can extend beyond the extract polygon; it is not a legal boundary or complete historical archive.
datasets.update_notes: Start with complete regional snapshot rebuilds. Later diffs must follow the exact regional replication stream and contiguous sequence. Publisher currently retains diffs for 100 days; missing chains require a fresh snapshot. Preserve extraction footprint changes.
datasets.join_cautions: Resolve way/relation members before filtering geometry dependencies. Deduplicate identical type/ID/version across extracts while retaining acquisition memberships. Separate different versions and roles; name/proximity alone cannot merge objects. Scope removal is not necessarily an OSM deletion.
datasets.quality_limits: Mapping coverage and semantics vary. PBF is the primary input; convenience GIS outputs lose tags/roles. Public snapshots omit contributor user/uid/changeset and full edit history. Report missing members, unresolved geometry and rejected records.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation, region page and discovery index inspected; no PBF payload download, geometry import or replication sequence was tested.
datasets.access_notes: Use index features[].properties.urls.pbf and urls.updates for selected region IDs, not guessed country paths. ISO-code fields are arrays. Portugal is an example only. Public PBF needs no OSM account; do not select pbf-internal/history. Detailed implementation contract: SOURCE_INTERFACES.md, Regional Geofabrik PBF acquisition.

datasets.name: GHSL GHS-BUILT-S R2023A built-up surface
datasets.reason: Global, temporally consistent built-up surface context for settlement expansion and coarse urban intensity around vector infrastructure.
datasets.format: GeoTIFF raster (ZIP packaging may include TIF/OVR); 100 m and 1 km World Mollweide EPSG:54009, plus 10 m 2018 product
datasets.license_name: European Commission reuse notice / open and free GHSL data
datasets.license_notes: JRC states reuse is authorised provided the source is acknowledged; individual copyright notices and third-party rights still apply. Direct FTP tree: https://jeodpp.jrc.ec.europa.eu/ftp/jrc-opendata/GHSL/GHS_BUILT_S_GLOBE_R2023A/.
datasets.coverage: Global raster grid; total and non-residential built-up surface estimates for 1975-2030 at five-year intervals, with a 10 m observed 2018 product.
datasets.update_notes: R2023A issued 2023-05-08 and catalogue modified 2025-02-27; update frequency is irregular. Pin product release, epoch, resolution, CRS, and tile metadata.
datasets.join_cautions: This is a cell-based raster with no building or facility IDs. Join by explicit zonal statistics or cell coordinates after CRS alignment; never fabricate feature IDs from pixel positions.
datasets.quality_limits: Values are modelled built-up square metres per cell, not surveyed footprints or precise construction dates. Temporal epochs relate to imagery and interpolation. It cannot establish occupancy, current use, or individual-building identity.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.

datasets.name: TeleGeography Submarine Cable Map / licensed map API
datasets.reason: High-value published reference for cable systems and landing points, but structured route data is licensed and public map geometry is a presentation layer requiring explicit accuracy and redistribution review.
datasets.format: Public regional/global JPG map downloads; licensed API delivered as timestamped ZIP containing JSON and GeoJSON via customer S3 bucket or secure FTP
datasets.license_name: TeleGeography commercial map-data license (annual license for structured data)
datasets.license_notes: TeleGeography says the JSON/GeoJSON API is delivered to a customer-controlled S3 bucket or secure FTP after an annual license. Public map images are free to view/download but are not an open structured redistribution license; obtain written terms before caching, exporting, or redistributing data.
datasets.coverage: Published global submarine cable systems and landing points; 2026 map page reports 694 systems and 1,893 landings active or under construction.
datasets.update_notes: Map editions are annual/publicly dated; licensed API uploads timestamped ZIPs whenever the map is updated. Treat release timestamp, planning/operational status, RFS date, and source edition as mandatory provenance.
datasets.join_cautions: Do not synthesize IDs from display names. Route lines may be generalized or illustrative; landings and systems can be renamed, merged, or planned. Require explicit license scope and route geometry status before joining to incidents or other infrastructure.
datasets.quality_limits: No public open route API was identified. The free map is not proof of exact seabed alignment, current service, or fault status. Keep as descriptive network context and do not use it for tactical vulnerability inference.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.

datasets.name: USGS Earthquake Catalog / FDSN Event Web Service
datasets.reason: Existing Relic interface; authoritative event history for earthquakes and complementary to fire, cyclone, and weather context.
datasets.format: GeoJSON (also CSV, QuakeML/XML, KML, text)
datasets.license_name: U.S. public domain (USGS; check dataset-specific rights)
datasets.license_notes: USGS scientific data are generally public domain in the United States; acknowledge USGS. Joint or third-party inputs can have different rights.
datasets.coverage: Global catalog; query-defined time and geographic bounds; official contract uses ISO 8601 times and inclusive endtime.
datasets.update_notes: Event origin, magnitude, location, and status may be revised. Use updatedafter and includedeleted reconciliation where supported; query limit is 20,000.
datasets.join_cautions: Do not equate magnitude with felt intensity or damage; revised parameters update one event. Keep origin time separate from catalog update time.
datasets.quality_limits: Detection, location, and magnitude completeness vary by region and time; a catalog event does not establish incident causality.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.

datasets.name: NASA FIRMS active fire detections
datasets.reason: Existing Relic interface; near-real-time and standard satellite thermal detections provide fire context without duplicating earthquake or weather records.
datasets.format: CSV (sensor-specific attributes; WMS/WFS alternatives)
datasets.license_name: NASA Earthdata open data guidance; product-specific use constraints
datasets.license_notes: NASA-sponsored ESDIS data are generally open and NASA requests acknowledgement; inspect product metadata for restrictions and required citation.
datasets.coverage: Global or bounding-box queries by supported sensor; most recent or date-started windows of 1–5 days. Sensor date availability must be queried.
datasets.update_notes: A free MAP_KEY is required and limited to 5,000 transactions per 10 minutes; NRT/RT/URT detections can be removed or superseded by standard processing. Preserve product version.
datasets.join_cautions: Thermal detection is not proof of a fire, cause, persistence, or attack. Match by acquisition UTC and spatial tolerance; do not count NRT and standard replacements as independent evidence.
datasets.quality_limits: Cloud, viewing geometry, pixel footprint, overpass timing, confidence and sensor coverage affect detection; no-data and failed responses must be distinguished.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.

datasets.name: International Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship (IBTrACS) v04r01
datasets.publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
datasets.reason: Optional bounded cyclone-history context; preserve provisional/final track and source-agency differences.
datasets.format: NetCDF4 (also CSV and point/line shapefiles)
datasets.license_name: NCEI IBTrACS terms: WDC open access and stated WMO commercial-use guidance
datasets.license_notes: NCEI states full and open access under WDC policy; preserve NOAA citation, DOI 10.25921/82ty-9e16, and originating-agency provenance.
datasets.coverage: Global tropical cyclones, approximately 70N–70S and 180W–180E; 1841-present in the archive, with incomplete pre-satellite history; positions commonly 0.1 degrees and interpolated to 3-hourly.
datasets.update_notes: v04r01 released June 2024 and updated roughly three times weekly; provisional US tracks can change or disappear after final reanalysis. Current directory timestamps are part of the source revision.
datasets.join_cautions: Best track is an expert reconstruction, not a forecast or raw observation. Do not compare wind intensity across agencies/basins without averaging-period handling; preserve provisional versus best-track status.
datasets.quality_limits: Known systems only; storm counts and intensity uncertainty are much worse in early decades. Source-agency practices and interpolation can create apparent differences.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.

datasets.name: ERA5 hourly data on single levels (1940-present)
datasets.reason: Use only for a bounded incident question needing wind, pressure, precipitation, sea-surface temperature, or wave context; it is a gridded reanalysis, not an observation or forecast.
datasets.format: GRIB; experimental NetCDF4; ARCO Zarr subset
datasets.license_name: Copernicus CC BY
datasets.license_notes: Dataset download requires CDS registration, licence acceptance, and attribution; CDS terms and dataset licence can change, so retain the accepted licence revision.
datasets.coverage: Global; 1940-present; hourly; 0.25-degree regular atmosphere grid, coarser ocean-wave grids; selected single-level variables.
datasets.update_notes: Daily updates with an early ERA5T release that can differ from the final product after later production; capture dataset short name, request, grid, API job/response, and retrieval time.
datasets.join_cautions: Sample or aggregate the grid explicitly around incident coordinates and time; do not treat interpolated grid values as station readings or independent confirmation of an incident.
datasets.quality_limits: Early decades and data-sparse regions have greater uncertainty; model and assimilation choices affect fields. Global backfills are expensive and exceed the minimal Relic extraction budget.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.

datasets.name: Integrated Surface Database (ISD / Global Hourly)
datasets.publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
datasets.reason: Valuable ground observations for validating weather context, but heterogeneous station histories, flags, gaps, and archive scale require a dedicated station-selection workflow.
datasets.format: ASCII fixed/common format; derived CSV and ISDLite; web-service alternatives
datasets.license_name: NOAA public domain / CC0-oriented open data policy
datasets.license_notes: NOAA/NCEI federal environmental data are generally public domain in the U.S.; contributed sources may carry different terms. Preserve attribution and source metadata.
datasets.coverage: Global station archive, observations from 1901-present; more than 20,000 stations available in the Global Hourly product, with uneven regional coverage and breaks in station records.
datasets.update_notes: Updated daily for active stations; NCEI estimates roughly 600 GB uncompressed. GHCNh v1.1 documentation (March 2026) identifies GHCNh as the successor to legacy Global Hourly/ISD, so assess migration before building an adapter.
datasets.join_cautions: Station identity and location histories matter; nearest-station joins can misrepresent an incident area. Do not ingest ISD and its GHCNh successor as independent confirmations.
datasets.quality_limits: Multiple contributing sources, missing periods, station moves, flags, changing instrumentation, and nonuniform spatial coverage limit comparability and field-like interpolation.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.

datasets.name: Copernicus Sentinel-2 Level-2A Collection 1
datasets.publisher: ESA / European Commission via Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem
datasets.reason: Global orthorectified surface reflectance with 10/20/60 m multispectral bands and SCL/AOT/WV quality context. It is the best first optical evidence layer, while remaining explicitly date- and mask-dependent.
datasets.format: SAFE product; CDSE STAC/S3 assets; Sentinel Hub OGC/Process rendered TIFF/PNG
datasets.license_name: Copernicus Sentinel Data Legal Notice (free, full and open)
datasets.license_notes: Attribution and rare security, third-party-rights or service-disruption limits apply.
datasets.coverage: Global; 2015-06-27-present in the live STAC collection. MSI bands: 10 m B02/B03/B04/B08, 20 m B05/B06/B07/B8A/B11/B12, 60 m B01/B09; approximately 110 km UTM/WGS84 MGRS tiles.
datasets.update_notes: Collection-1 reprocessing and processing-baseline changes must be retained; live STAC exposes product type S2MSI2A and NRT/24-hour timeliness metadata.
datasets.join_cautions: Native UTM/MGRS grids differ by zone; mosaicking/resampling changes pixels. Same-day duplicates, reprocessed products and per-tile cloud estimates require explicit deduplication and masks.
datasets.quality_limits: Optical clouds, shadows, cirrus, snow, saturation and missing data remain possible; SCL/dataMask is required. A rendered basemap is context, not dated incident evidence; no automatic damage verdict.
datasets.verification_notes: Live STAC collection metadata sampled. No image pixels, complete scene search, authenticated download or raster import validated.

datasets.name: Copernicus Sentinel-1 Level-1 GRD
datasets.publisher: ESA / European Commission via Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem
datasets.reason: All-weather, day/night C-band complement to optical imagery, useful for persistent observation and change review when clouds or illumination block Sentinel-2.
datasets.format: SAFE zipped product; growing COG_SAFE GeoTIFF band assets; STAC metadata
datasets.license_name: Copernicus Sentinel Data Legal Notice (free, full and open)
datasets.license_notes: Attribution and rare security, third-party-rights or service-disruption limits apply.
datasets.coverage: Global; 2014-10-04-present in live STAC extent. C-band; VV/VH/HH/HV where acquired. IW/SM high pixel spacing about 10 m and EW about 25 m; medium about 40 m.
datasets.update_notes: COG_SAFE conversion began in 2023 and older archive conversion is progressive; original SAFE availability and timeliness vary. STAC advertises processing versions and NRT/Fast-24h categories.
datasets.join_cautions: Compare like-for-like acquisition mode, polarization, orbit and incidence geometry. Declare beta0/sigma0/gamma0 calibration and terrain correction; GRD loses phase and is not a direct optical pixel match.
datasets.quality_limits: Speckle, layover, foreshortening, radar shadow, thermal-noise and incidence-angle effects require masks and interpretation. Single-scene amplitude is not an automatic damage verdict.
datasets.verification_notes: Live STAC collection metadata sampled. No image pixels, complete scene search, authenticated download or raster import validated.

datasets.name: USGS Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 Surface Reflectance
datasets.reason: Long global archive from 1982 supports historical context and cross-checking against Sentinel observations, with per-pixel QA and cloud-optimized assets.
datasets.format: Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF bands; MTL/XML/JSON metadata; STAC JSON; EarthExplorer/M2M downloads
datasets.license_name: USGS Landsat Data Policy / public domain
datasets.license_notes: USGS requests credit such as 'Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 image courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey.'
datasets.coverage: Global; 1982-08-22-present for Landsat 4-9 Level-2 SR. Reflective SR bands are 30 m; standard scene products use UTM/WGS84. Albers ARD is a separate collection/grid.
datasets.update_notes: Products are generated after Tier 1/2 processing; reprocessing and known issues are documented by USGS. Landsat 4-7 uses LEDAPS and Landsat 8-9 uses LaSRC.
datasets.join_cautions: Sensor spectral responses and grids differ from Sentinel-2; standard scenes and Albers ARD must not be joined by coordinates without reprojection. Prefer Tier 1 for time series and retain Collection-1/2 lineage.
datasets.quality_limits: Cloud, cloud shadow, snow, water, aerosol, saturation and terrain occlusion require QA_PIXEL/QA_RADSAT/SR QA masks. Temporal gaps and differing sun/view geometry limit pixel-level change claims.
datasets.verification_notes: Live STAC collection metadata sampled. No image pixels, complete scene search, authenticated download or raster import validated.

datasets.name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30
datasets.publisher: ESA / European Commission via Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem
datasets.reason: Preferred optional global surface-elevation product when terrain context is needed; does not require a global terrain download.
datasets.format: 1°x1° GeoTIFF DGED (32-bit float) or DTED (16-bit signed); Editing/Filling/Height Error/Water Body masks
datasets.license_name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30/GLO-90 free license with ESA mission-specific conditions
datasets.license_notes: General-public download of GLO-30/GLO-90 requires registration and attribution; other instances have eligibility restrictions and source notices.
datasets.coverage: Worldwide land surface; 30 m (1 arc-second) GLO-30. Horizontal WGS84-G1150/EPSG:4326; vertical EGM2008/EPSG:3855; metres; RasterPixelIsPoint.
datasets.update_notes: CDSE documents releases 2019_1 through 2024_1, including infilling, corrections and license changes. Pin release plus geocell tsxx:tileVersion.
datasets.join_cautions: This is a DSM with buildings, vegetation and infrastructure retained, not a bare-earth DTM. Reproject horizontal coordinates and convert vertical datum before combining with local elevation or line-of-sight data.
datasets.quality_limits: Water flattening, void/infill areas, steep terrain and known tile-edge or maintenance edits affect local values; stated absolute vertical accuracy is under 4 m at 90% linear error, not a guarantee for every tile.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.
datasets.access_notes: Documented datasetFull filter is a discovery template. Add explicit bounds/pagination and inspect returned product metadata; this query and downloads were not live-tested.

datasets.name: ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200
datasets.reason: A global, high-resolution thematic baseline for stratifying map context and describing land cover around an evidence location.
datasets.format: Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF; 3°x3° EPSG:4326 tiles; Map layer plus optional three-band InputQuality layer
datasets.license_name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
datasets.license_notes: Use ESA WorldCover/Copernicus Sentinel attribution. Public AWS map access needs no AWS account with --no-sign-request; viewer/Terrascope requires login.
datasets.coverage: Global 2021 reference-year map; 2651 tiles at approximately 10 m. Eleven Map classes; global Map layer is approximately 117 GB. InputQuality is not available through every delivery route.
datasets.update_notes: v200 released for 2021; v100 is the separate 2020 algorithm. Annual product is static by reference year, not near-real-time, and Zenodo macrotiles are multi-GB.
datasets.join_cautions: 3° tile boundaries and geographic EPSG:4326 require careful reprojection/resampling. Differences between 2020 v100 and 2021 v200 mix real land-cover change with algorithm change.
datasets.quality_limits: The categorical map is a thematic snapshot without a current observation time per pixel; class confusion and source-image quality remain. Use InputQuality where available and never infer incident damage from class changes alone.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.

datasets.name: UCDP Georeferenced Event Dataset (GED) Global v26.1
datasets.publisher: Uppsala Conflict Data Program, Uppsala University
datasets.reason: Preferred optional curated historical organized-violence layer; not a first-release requirement or live alert feed.
datasets.format: CSV, Excel; REST API JSON
datasets.license_name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
datasets.license_notes: UCDP catalogue states current datasets are free to use and redistribute with citation; retain the release and required citations.
datasets.coverage: Global organized-violence events, 1989-2025 in v26.1; individual events disaggregated by day and geocoded as precisely as sources permit.
datasets.update_notes: Annual finalized GED releases; UCDP Candidate is a separate monthly, less-final product. Store release number and import snapshot.
datasets.join_cautions: Use persistent id, not relid. Preserve uncertainty, source_article and release. Actor/conflict/dyad identifiers before 17.1 use different namespaces; never join on coordinates alone. Absence is not no event.
datasets.quality_limits: Newswire, BBC Monitoring, local media, NGO/IGO and other source coverage varies by place and time; summary reporting can reduce event and location precision. Fatality estimates are reported/coded values, not a complete census.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.

datasets.name: Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System (GDACS) events and alerts
datasets.publisher: GDACS (United Nations OCHA, European Commission JRC/ECHO, and partners)
datasets.reason: Compact near-real-time sudden-onset hazard alerts and modelled impact estimates; useful for triage and alerting alongside a finalized occurrence source.
datasets.format: GeoJSON API; XML feeds; KML for recent/single events
datasets.license_name: GDACS Terms of Use (free API; attribution requested)
datasets.license_notes: Terms request acknowledgement and provide no conventional open-data licence; upstream scientific, official, and third-party inputs may have separate rights.
datasets.coverage: Global sudden-onset earthquakes, tsunamis, tropical cyclones, floods and volcanoes, with alert levels and modelled exposure/impact estimates.
datasets.update_notes: Near-real-time notifications; event and alert values can change without notice. API supports eventtype/eventid/episodeid/source lookups and date/alert filters.
datasets.join_cautions: An event episode and its successive alerts are not separate disasters; use eventtype+eventid+episodeid+source and retain update/advisory timestamps. Do not equate alert level or affected-population estimate with observed impact.
datasets.quality_limits: Automatic model outputs are preliminary and uncertain; completeness and timeliness are not guaranteed, and alerts do not replace national authorities or official warnings.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.
datasets.access_notes: Swagger is the interface locator, not a data response. The existing bounded endpoint contract is in SOURCE_INTERFACES.md. Keep upstream lineage, including USGS-derived inputs, to avoid false independence.

datasets.name: ReliefWeb API v2 reports and disasters
datasets.reason: A practical report and disaster catalogue for attaching situation reports, assessments and source evidence to an occurrence or alert record.
datasets.format: JSON over read-only HTTP API
datasets.license_name: ReliefWeb API terms; underlying partner content rights retained by original sources
datasets.license_notes: Free public API with appname requirement and quotas. OCHA warns reports may contain copyrighted material owned by information partners; respect original-source rights and avoid unlicensed redistribution of report bodies.
datasets.coverage: Continuously updated humanitarian reports, documents and disaster groupings; disaster records include event date, GLIDE and country/type metadata.
datasets.update_notes: Current API is v2; records expose created, changed and original dates. Maximum 1,000 entries per call and 1,000 calls/day; use an approved appname from 2025-11-01.
datasets.join_cautions: Report id is a document identity; disaster.id/GLIDE is a grouping identity. date.original and disaster.date.event are different concepts. One disaster has many reports; counts are document counts, not event or casualty counts.
datasets.quality_limits: Partner reporting is selective, may be delayed or revised, and ReliefWeb does not guarantee accuracy. Document body, images and attachments can carry source-specific copyright.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.

datasets.name: ACLED political violence and demonstration event data
datasets.reason: Rich global, weekly event coverage that complements UCDP with demonstrations, non-lethal political disorder and strategic developments, subject to a product licence gate.
datasets.format: JSON or CSV API export
datasets.license_name: ACLED EULA and Content Usage Terms (2025)
datasets.license_notes: Account/API access required. Non-commercial use is subject to EULA and attribution terms; commercial exploitation, redistribution, or incorporation into a product requires a written commercial licence. Rights are unresolved for Relic until confirmed.
datasets.coverage: Every country and territory since the 2022 global expansion; political violence, demonstrations and selected non-violent strategic developments, coded by event/day/location/actors.
datasets.update_notes: Coded in real time and published weekly. Living dataset; events can be corrected or supplemented and ACLED no longer releases formal dataset versions. Save snapshots, timestamps and deleted endpoint results.
datasets.join_cautions: event_id_cnty is persistent when details update, but rows are ACLED’s event unit and may not match UCDP or report units. Coordinates are named-place centroids with geo_precision; preserve time_precision and source/source_scale.
datasets.quality_limits: Reporting bias, partisan claims, unequal local access and source changes affect trends; fatalities are reported estimates, and zero can mean no fatality was reported. API updates can revise history.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.

datasets.name: GDELT 2.0 Event Database and Mentions
datasets.reason: Excellent global news discovery and media-attention signal, but its event rows are automated extractions from articles and Mentions rows are article observations; unsuitable as Relic’s authoritative occurrence ledger.
datasets.format: Tab-delimited compressed files; BigQuery tables; event and mentions streams
datasets.license_name: GDELT Project Terms of Use (unrestricted with attribution)
datasets.license_notes: Project permits unrestricted academic, commercial and governmental use and redistribution with attribution; individual source articles and linked media remain subject to their own rights and availability.
datasets.coverage: Global news-derived CAMEO coding. The documented 2.0 stream starts in February 2015; the separate 1.0 historical series extends to 1979. Verify actual available files before promising a window; do not conflate generations.
datasets.update_notes: Use DATEADDED and file/update timestamps for ingestion; GDELT is continuously revised by stream processing rather than a stable analytical release. SOURCEURL is generally the first report found; Mentions records each article mention.
datasets.join_cautions: GlobalEventID is an extracted event identity, not a verified real-world incident key. Ten articles can yield one event and ten mentions; do not compare article/mention counts with UCDP, ACLED, GDACS or ReliefWeb occurrences.
datasets.quality_limits: Automated extraction/geocoding and news selection introduce language, outlet, duplication, censorship and newsworthiness bias. DATEADDED is processing time, not occurrence time; URLs can disappear or change.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.

datasets.name: GLEIF Global LEI Index (API + Golden Copy/deltas)
datasets.reason: Preferred optional exact legal-entity lookup; local bulk indexing only when needed. LEI coverage is not a universal company population.
datasets.format: JSON:API; Golden Copy XML/CSV/JSON; delta files
datasets.license_name: CC0 1.0 Universal
datasets.license_notes: GLEIF terms state free access and CC0; attribution/brand use remains subject to terms.
datasets.coverage: Entities with LEIs globally; coverage is voluntary/market-driven and uneven by jurisdiction.
datasets.update_notes: API based on Golden Copy; Golden Copy released three times daily with intra-day/day/week/month deltas; preserve lifecycle and successor changes.
datasets.join_cautions: LEI is exact join key. Parent data is accounting consolidation relationship, not a complete beneficial-ownership/control register. Name/address fuzzy hits are ambiguous; corroborate jurisdiction and registration ID.
datasets.quality_limits: Third-party supplied records; GLEIF disclaims accuracy/currentness/uniqueness warranties. Missing parents and reporting exceptions are meaningful states.

datasets.name: WorldPop Global2 population counts R2025A v1
datasets.reason: Use only for a scoped country, polygon or incident date when annual nominal 100 m population and age/sex estimates are needed. The API supports polygon totals and avoids a global 100 m bulk ingest.
datasets.format: GeoTIFF raster; API JSON response
datasets.license_name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (default)
datasets.license_notes: WorldPop states CC BY 4.0 for its datasets; inspect the selected release because source-derived layers can have different terms. Attribution required.
datasets.coverage: 242 countries; 2015-2030 annually; country files at nominal 100 m and 1 km; residential population count with age/sex variants; WGS84 geographic grid per WorldPop FAQ for people-per-pixel products.
datasets.update_notes: R2025A v1 Global2 release; WorldPop updates when new census/geospatial inputs or stakeholder needs are available. API v2 requires WGS84 GeoJSON, year, and resolution; larger functionality may require a bearer/API key and rate limits apply.
datasets.join_cautions: Raster cells have no person-level identity. Join by geospatial overlay and georeference; do not assume administrative IDs. Sum valid count cells only, preserve release and selected constrained/adjusted variant, and area-preserve any reprojection.
datasets.quality_limits: Modelled residential estimates, not persons actually present during an incident. Census age, projection horizon, conflict/disaster migration and small-area random-forest error can dominate. NoData/value encoding is release-specific; do not assume zero is NoData. Do not infer casualties or protected-class traits from location.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.

datasets.name: GHS-POP R2023A population grid multitemporal
datasets.reason: Best global baseline for Relic: stable JRC PID, global multi-temporal coverage, explicit count/density CRS variants, documented NoData and tile downloads. Keep only needed epochs/tiles in the working set.
datasets.format: GeoTIFF raster, tiled or single global layer with pyramids
datasets.license_name: European Commission GHSL open/free data reuse conditions
datasets.license_notes: Reuse is authorised provided the source is acknowledged. Check the page and any bundled third-party boundary terms before redistribution.
datasets.coverage: Global resident population; estimates 1975-2020 and projections 2025/2030 at five-year intervals; 100 m and 1 km World Mollweide ESRI:54009, plus 3 arcsec and 30 arcsec WGS84 EPSG:4326. Population is people per cell; density is a separate measure.
datasets.update_notes: R2023A product; JRC download wizard offers tiles and may defer single-file generation. Product/layer IDs encode epoch, extent, release, CRS, resolution and version, e.g. GHS_POP_E2020_GLOBE_R2023A_54009_100_V1_0.
datasets.join_cautions: Use population-count layers for zonal sums and density layers for density analysis; never mix them. Reproject before overlay with declared resampling and area rules. Align epochs to the event date; a cell is a modelled residential stock, not observed presence.
datasets.quality_limits: Float64 non-negative values with NoData -200. Disaggregation follows census/administrative units and GHSL built-up evidence, so census age, boundary mismatch and rapidly changing populations limit small-area accuracy. No casualty or ethnicity/religion inference is valid.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.

datasets.name: GHS-SMOD R2023A settlement model
datasets.reason: Add as lightweight settlement context alongside GHS-POP to distinguish rural, cluster, suburban and urban settings in a case footprint; it is not a population or exposure count.
datasets.format: GeoTIFF categorical raster
datasets.license_name: European Commission GHSL open/free data reuse conditions
datasets.license_notes: JRC states open/free reuse with source acknowledgement; check any bundled boundary data separately.
datasets.coverage: Global 1 km World Mollweide ESRI:54009 raster; epochs 1975-2030 at five-year intervals; Degree of Urbanisation stage I, detailed L2 classes with L1 obtainable by documented aggregation.
datasets.update_notes: R2023A; direct download is tile-based or global where available. Layer ID example GHS_SMOD_E2030_GLOBE_R2023A_54009_1000_V2_0.
datasets.join_cautions: Categorical values: -200 NoData, 10 water, 11-30 settlement classes. Use categorical remapping or majority rules; never sum or average codes and do not treat urban class as exposed population. Pair with GHS-POP for counts.
datasets.quality_limits: Classes are derived from GHSL population and built-up surfaces and inherit their model and epoch limits. They describe settlement morphology/class, not who is present, vulnerability, casualty counts, ethnicity or religion.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.

datasets.name: OCHA HDX Common Operational Dataset population
datasets.publisher: United Nations OCHA Centre for Humanitarian Data and country contributors
datasets.reason: Use for a named country/operation when current administrative baseline totals and humanitarian p-codes are more useful than a global raster. Do not make it a global default because coverage and freshness are record-specific.
datasets.format: Record-specific: CSV/XLSX, zipped shapefile, GeoJSON, or other supported format
datasets.license_name: Record-specific contributor license; unknown until package metadata is checked
datasets.license_notes: HDX supports CC BY-IGO, CC0, multiple licenses and Other; the contributor selects the applicable terms. Read the exact package/resource license before reuse or redistribution.
datasets.coverage: Country-by-country baseline population, commonly aggregated by administrative division and often age/sex; associated COD boundaries and p-codes. Not a globally harmonised raster or guaranteed global time series.
datasets.update_notes: As-needed and contributor-dependent. Inspect package/resource modified date, reference year/date, source and completeness on every acquisition. HDX reported a material decline in baseline-population availability in 2025. HDX Tabular Data Endpoints exist for some resources and require an HDX API token.
datasets.join_cautions: Do not combine overlapping admin levels or silently crosswalk changed boundary vintages. Preserve source and p-code version; reconcile geometry to the exact reference boundary. Follow the record license and do not expose sensitive operational detail.
datasets.quality_limits: Admin totals can be census-based, projected or operational estimates; geography, age/sex detail and update age vary by country. HDX review does not make records temporally current. Population baseline is not event presence and cannot support casualty or protected-class inference.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.

datasets.name: UNHCR Refugee Data Finder population and displacement statistics
datasets.publisher: United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR)
datasets.reason: Use when an investigation needs explicit displacement stocks, asylum/refugee types, demographics where available, or UNHCR flow records. It complements resident-population exposure and cannot be spatialized as a global raster.
datasets.format: JSON REST response; CSV when download=true
datasets.license_name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International, subject to UNHCR supplemental dataset terms (default)
datasets.license_notes: UNHCR states CC BY 4.0 except where otherwise indicated and requires attribution to UNHCR and data providers; inspect specific source/record terms.
datasets.coverage: Annual end-year stocks and related statistics: refugees since 1951, asylum-seekers since 2000, IDPs of concern since 1993, plus other categories; demographics and sub-national location only where reported. Mid-year/current-year data are separate from end-year data.
datasets.update_notes: UNHCR publishes population statistics every six months; demographics are only collected in end-year statistics. API supports year, origin/asylum ISO3 or UNHCR codes, population type and pagination; use /population/v1/demographics/ for available age/sex/location detail. Flow records are separately documented by UNHCR.
datasets.join_cautions: Stocks are end-of-period totals; flows are movements during a period. Never infer a flow from stock differences, add overlapping population categories, or treat host-country stock as resident population. Small values are rounded for protection and are not person-level observations.
datasets.quality_limits: Reported by governments, UNHCR operations and partner sources; coverage and definitions vary by population type and place. Demographic/location fields are incomplete and can be rounded or redacted. Do not infer casualty counts, routes, ethnicity or religion.
datasets.verification_notes: Publisher documentation reviewed; no dataset payload import or complete quality validation performed.
